levels.surface: الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن عيسى

notes: «وَ عَنِ الْأَصْبَغِ» is read as continuing one chain (Minhal, then Asbagh, then Zadhan), as the Thaqalayn English gives it; a reading with Minhal and Asbagh as co-transmitters is not chosen
«عمن ذكره» is an unnamed gap: the text does not name the man
Ali is named in the words after the chain («سمعت علي بن أبي طالب (ع) ... يقول»): the last link, kind imam_in_text, as the report names him
